v: Telugu pride hype pakkana petti normal historical movie ga chusthe GOOD one 👍 Krish sharp ga handles it, dialogues roar... and honestly Satakarni ga Balayya ne set avthadu.
e: Gautamiputra Satakarni worked for me as a solid period film rather than the oversized cultural event surrounding its release. Krish and Balakrishna put in their best effort, the dialogues are excellent and the direction is focused; considering the budget, schedule and the physical demands on its lead, the result is genuinely impressive even if I would stop short of calling it essential viewing.
body: Watched #GPSK…..a good movie with best efforts from Krish n Bala Krishna…..n yes no one could have suited the role better than balaya babu. Will not say its a must watch but definetly a good watch, dont go with all the hype about Telugu jathi gawravam etc…..its just a normal periodic movie with excellent dialoges n perfect direction and who else we have other than balaya babu to mouth those terrific dialoges!!! Considering the limitations budget time and balaya’s age n size its a Fantastic movie

v: FILM ga loved it 🙏 Real-life story ga మాత్రం father ni hero chesi daughters’ sacrifice ni pakkana pettadam naaku digest avvaledu. Great cinema, complicated feeling.
e: Dangal is superbly made cinema, with exceptional casting and visible commitment from every performer and technician. My major reservation is not the filmmaking but the real-life framing: I could not fully celebrate a story that seemed to glorify Mahavir Phogat’s methods more than the daughters who sacrificed so much to fulfil his ambition.
body:
Watched #Dangal…..as a FILM just loved it to the core and each n every artist technician put his 300% which completely shows on the Silver Screen, the casting was pitch perfect

BUT considering that it was a real life story….I hated it to the core, somehow i felt that rather than glorifying the Phogat Sisters who sacrificed everything to fulfill their fathers dream…it tried to glorify a father who without any mercy forced his daughters to achieve his own dreams.

I fully understand that his dream was to get a medal for the nation but that doesnt mean he simply rubs his wish over them….are we making mr.Phogat a hero just because his daughters made the nation proud?? what if the poor girls failed??

If he is hero, then all those parents who force their children to become eng or doctors are also heros….

v: RGV movie lo camera, lights, BGM, acting usually untayi... STORYే missing avvachu 😄 This time story కూడా undi. Situations ni villain ga cheyyadam lo master still master.
e: Vangaveeti gave me the RGV craft I expected — haunting BGM, striking visuals, balanced dialogues and unconventional staging — but this time with a story strong enough to match it. What I especially liked is that the film avoids simple hero-villain labels and instead lets circumstance and miscommunication become the real destructive forces, capped by a final line that reminded me why I admire RGV’s storytelling instincts.
body:
#Vangaveeti : genral ga RGV cinemalo Taking Camera Lights BGM Acting anii awesome untayi….okka story thappa. Essari Story guda undhi!!!

The beauty of RGV’s style is okaaa controversial subject tesukoni……..andhullo evaro okkalu hero inkollu villan annatu kakundaaa, Situations and Miscommunication ni Villan ga chupinchi migitha anni charachters neither hero nor villans anatu chupinchadam. No one can do that better than him!!!

BGM as usual migitha RGV movies laage will haunt you….dialogues again chala balanced gaa impact creat chesedatu unnayi

Cinema ni release kakunda cheyadaniki evaru ayithe godava chesaarooo…vaallaa meedha chala sweet n hot revenge terchukunaadu 😛 u will know it once u watch the movie!!!

Final ga Cinema motham oka ethu….last lo vacheeee dialogue oka ethu, that simply shows how geneius the master is 🙂

v: What a movie 🙏 SRK super mature ga untadu... but after some time screen meeda Alia kanapadadu, only KAIRA. Their combo is such a lovely treat.
e: Dear Zindagi turns a confused, emotionally messy young woman — the kind of person many of us know as a sibling, cousin, friend or colleague — into a warm and recognisable story. Shah Rukh Khan is wonderfully mature and generous, but Alia Bhatt disappears so completely into Kaira that she makes you laugh, pity her, get irritated with her and cry with her, all backed by excellent situational music.
body:
what a movie……Gauri Shinde is bang on Target!!!! If English Vinglish was all about an House Wife, this is all about a young girl (whow we all encounter in our daily life as any of our sibiling, cousin, friend, collegue or girl friend etc) who cant take decisions………

SRK : This year he proved again who is the Badshah of acting in Bollywood…..another auperb performance from him after Fan. I havent seen such a matured and impact performance from him after Chak De & Swadesh!!! n the way he created space for Alia to perform….Man the combination of SRK n Alia was treat to watch!!!

Aaaliaaaaa : the wonder kid of Bhatt shaabh!!! after RGV she is the only one for whom i can have a argument with anyone 🙂 all the way i went to watch Alia in the film….but what i was shocked to see was there was no Aliaa…..its KAIRA!!! she makes you laugh on her, feel pitty for her, get irriated by her, cry with her….for the first time I have seen SRK to come up with extra ordinary performance to match to his costar (after amitabh)!!! while she can do all these kind of Highway, Udtha & Dear Zindagi roles…she is just 23!!!

Music has been really good & situational….esp songs and lyrics were awesome

on end note…..would love to watch RGV & Alia working together soon!!!
